description: This is a C# code-behind file for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that provides functionality for editing multiple-choice questions (MCQs) in an online examination system. The code handles page load, navigation buttons, course selection based on semester/year, and session management.

classes.name: EditMCQ
classes.description: Code-behind class for the EditMCQ ASP.NET page, managing user interactions and navigation for editing questions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles initial page load; currently empty.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to AdminPanel.aspx when home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to AdminQueue.aspx when profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to AdminLeaderboard.aspx when leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown list based on the selected semester/year.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Stores selected course in session variable '_CRS1'.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Transfers user to LoginPage.aspx to log out.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course list based on semester/year selected.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Empty handler for course dropdown change event.
